payload.headline: NOW - Starmer when asked why he won't step aside, as his popularity is dragging Labour down, says that he acknowledges the voters' widespread frustration, including "some frustration" with him persona
payload.body: NOW - Starmer when asked why he won't step aside, as his popularity is dragging Labour down, says that he acknowledges the voters' widespread frustration, including "some frustration" with him personally, but attributes it to deep, long-term failures of the status quo. @disclosetv
